title: test_kb_mcp.py holds a literal U+2028 and U+2029, so selfdoc's tools map puts its tests at the wrong lines and test_tools_map_this_repository_parses_and_holds fails
goal: _tools/test_kb_mcp.py writes the SSE separators as escapes, so no _tools file holds a literal U+2028 or U+2029, selfdoc.check_map finds every test_kb_mcp.py test at its def line, and test_live_docs_cache_sse_splits_only_at_cr_and_lf still plants each separator
